title: Add operator crypto audit playbook and region-assertion adapter
author: Priya Malhotra
release_notes: Adds an operator-focused crypto audit runbook, region-assertion middleware for KMS calls, and RBAC policy templates for storing audit retention windows. Backwards-compatible rollout with feature flag. Not visible to end users.
body: Context: recent audits highlighted gaps in operator-level telemetry for cryptographic KMS activity (key wrap/unwrap, transient key leases) and inconsistent region-pin assertions emitted by upstream services. This change adds an operator crypto audit playbook, an adapter that injects and validates region-assertion headers for KMS calls, and RBACv2 templates to surface per-operator retention and attestation obligations. Motivation: give security/compliance teams deterministic evidence during post-incident reviews and make operator-scoped crypto usage auditable without changing customer-facing APIs. What this PR does: 1) runtime/adapter: introduce region-assertion-adapter that decorates KMS requests with signed region claims, validates responses' provenance, and emits structured audit events to the audit pipeline; 2) policy: add rbacv2/operator-retention-templates that map operator roles to audit retention classes and consent scopes; 3) playbook: add docs/playbooks/crypto-operator-audit.md with step-by-step runbook for triage, artifacts to collect, and checklists for legal/regulatory handoff; 4) telemetry: add metrics and traces (kms.region_assertion.{validate,failed}, audit.playbook.run_count) and link to Console dashboards; 5) tests: unit tests for adapter signing/verification and integration test that simulates cross-region KMS failover; 6) rollout: feature-flag gated (feature.flags.crypto_audit_adapter) with staged rollout to 10% then 100% and synthetic monitoring for latency/99p token path. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for adapter signing/verification; - [x] Integration test for KMS failover + assertion fallback; - [x] RBAC templates reviewed by compliance; - [x] Playbook reviewed by Legal; - [x] Feature flag and metric hooks added; Related: ENG-9842 for platform telemetry and SUP-4321 for a customer support escalation that surfaced missing operator audit trails. Testing notes: synthetic test harness added under benchmark-lab/testdata/crypto-assertion to simulate signed region claims and stale-token scenarios. Operational considerations: adapter verifies that region claims are signed by an operator-attestor service (new microservice stubbed here), a CA rotation path was added to docs, and a mitigation path triggers KMS local fallback when assertion validation fails to avoid hard outages. Security review: encryption signing keys are stored in tenant-scoped keystores and never emitted in plaintext to logs. Migration and backward compatibility: adapter is opt-in behind feature flag; RBAC templates are additive and do not alter existing policies. Rollout plan: 10% -> monitor error budget for 72h -> 50% -> 100% after no anomalies. Followups: add automated audit summarizer and Legal retention exporter (separate PR).

review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Can the adapter fall back to non-asserted KMS calls when the attestor service is unreachable? We should avoid hard outages for customer traffic.
Priya Malhotra (author): Adapter is configured to fallback to local KMS path; fallback is controlled by feature flags and emits a high-severity audit event so SRE/Compliance can trace the window.
